name: WillPopScope
desc: When a WillPopScope component is present in an interface, a callback is triggered when the page returns, determining whether to return. It can be used for scenarios requiring secondary confirmation before exiting.

fields.name: child
fields.desc: The widget below this widget in the tree.

fields.name: onWillPop
fields.desc: Called to veto attempts by the user to dismiss the enclosing [ModalRoute].
